headline: Oil Prices Decline Amid Global Equity Selloff Despite Gulf Shipping Attacks
summary: Crude oil futures fell as wider financial market weakness offset persistent security threats to shipping in the Persian Gulf. Weakness in tech equities weighed on commodity market sentiment.
why: Brent and WTI crude benchmarks serve as global pricing anchors for international petroleum trade.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Macroeconomic demand concerns outweighed supply disruption risks in global oil markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Oil prices declined as broader market risk aversion depressed commodity demand expectations.
